1.consolidated_definition: mod. Tipo de media o calcetín, corto, caliente y con volantes, generalmente parte de un uniforme, que se hizo muy popular en la década de 1940. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Las niñas de primero a sexto grado: DiarioBlusa blanca, jumper azul marino, medias blancas (bobby socks), zapatos Ajumpingjacks o de cordones (Reglamento del Estudiante, -2008)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Type of footwear or sock, short, warm and with laces, generally part of a uniform, that became very popular in the 1940s. Raw anglicism, infrequently used. First to sixth-grade girls: White blouse, navy blue jumper, white socks (bobby socks), either Jumping Jack shoes or lace-up shoes (Student Regulation, -2008)
